cfg.port: Local port of the panel server (127.0.0.1 only).
cfg.days: How many days of Claude Code sessions to scan for background tasks.
cfg.usageDays: How many days of Claude Code history the AI Usage tab sums (tokens and cost).
cfg.notify.waiting: Notify when a Claude Code session stops and waits for you.
cfg.notify.tasks: Notify when a background command or subagent ends (completed, failed, killed or stopped).
cfg.notify.limit: Notify when plan usage passes 80% and 95%, and when the current pace reaches 100% within the hour.
